how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Sports Authority of India Director Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.sportsauthorityofindia.nic.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 04-11-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Sports Authority of India for filling up various positions under government deputation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post name is Director, which falls under the government sector category.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Director post?
faq.answer: A total of 6 vacancies have been announced for the Director position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for Sports Authority of India Director Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Offline. Candidates need to send their applications through the proper channel to the designated address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form is 04-11-2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Director position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is set at 56 years as per the official notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for this role?
faq.answer: Candidates must be officers working under Central/State Governments with an analogous post as Director (Level-12) or at least 5 years regular service in Pay Level-11.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Director position will be placed in Level-12 of the pay matrix as per government standards.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General, OBC, SC, and ST categories for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Director post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the candidates involves an Interview followed by the preparation of a final Merit List.
